title: The Second Course of Rank Fire
summary: Carries the drilled firing line a step further, adding qi to the volley and to the change of rank.

title: The Wad-and-Ball Treatise
summary: Teaches how wad, patch and ball are chosen and seated, and how qi keeps a sealed load flying flat.

title: Skirmisher's Handling of the Long Gun
summary: Trains scouts and skirmishers to fire from cover, shift ground quickly and use qi to run and shoot.

title: On Bayonet Work in the Press
summary: Teaches the short thrust, the withdrawal and the ward for fighting hand to hand among crowded ranks.

title: A Treatise on Qi-Steadied Aim
summary: Sets out qi-assisted aiming, from the steadied hold to the guided ball, for the careful single shot.

title: Lock Pan and Flint Craft
summary: Teaches upkeep of the flintlock and fast recovery from misfires, with a pulse of qi to wake a weak spark.

title: The Covering-Fire Handbook
summary: Shows how one group fires to pin the foe while another advances, and how the roles change by turns.

title: Musket Butt and Barrel Guard Forms
summary: Teaches defence and counterstrikes with the stock and barrel when the shot is spent and the foe is close.

title: The Smoke-Line Canon
summary: Treats fighting inside the thick powder haze of a long engagement, and clearing a lane through it with qi.
